defs.meaning: 异我中心的；非自我中心的

examples.en: The result indicated that the size of the spatial reference did not change the relationship between ego - and allocentric representations.
examples.zh: 研究结果表明客体参照物的大小不能调节自我参照和客体参照的关系。

examples.en: Here we investigated whether the size of the reference mediate the relationship between ego - and allo-centric representations in allocentric perception.
examples.zh: 本研究考察是否参照物的大小影响了自我参照和客体参照的关系。
